# ghost/tiktok_ios

TikTok iOS automation smoke skill using Appium/WebDriverAgent

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/tiktok_ios
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios open_app_smoke --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios search_smoke --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios profile_smoke --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios open_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios dismiss_popup --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios tap_search --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios type_and_search --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios navigate_to_profile --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios capture_visible_text --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios wait_visible_text --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tiktok_ios verify_visible_text --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_app_smoke`: Launch TikTok on iOS and dismiss common first-run prompts
- `search_smoke`: Launch TikTok on iOS, open search, and submit a query
- `profile_smoke`: Launch TikTok on iOS, navigate to Profile, and capture visible text evidence
- `open_app`: Launch TikTok on iOS
- `dismiss_popup`: Dismiss common TikTok iOS popups when visible
- `tap_search`: Tap TikTok iOS search control
- `type_and_search`: Type a query into TikTok iOS search and submit
- `navigate_to_profile`: Tap TikTok iOS Profile tab
- `capture_visible_text`: Capture visible TikTok iOS text for workflow evidence
- `wait_visible_text`: Wait until expected TikTok iOS text is visible
- `verify_visible_text`: Verify expected text appears in TikTok iOS XML
